map.压缩比和汽油标号什么关系？: How does compression ratio relate to fuel grade?
map.压缩比越高，混合气受压升温越剧烈，越易爆震，通常需更高辛烷值汽油抑制。自然吸气: A higher compression ratio heats the mixture more under compression and knocks more easily, usually calling for higher octane to suppress it. Naturally aspirated engines near 10:1 commonly use 92–95 RON; turbocharged or high-compression (>10:1) engines mostly need 95/98 RON. Follow the manufacturer's rating; blindly dropping the grade causes knock and damages the engine.
